item.title: Trump warns of Iranian 'sleeper cells' as Canada accused of harboring regime operatives
item.summary: Canadian Conservatives slam Liberal government for allegedly allowing hundreds of Iranian regime officials to remain despite known security risks.

item.title: Trump says Iran’s World Cup participation may not be ‘appropriate,’ while adding men’s team is still ‘welcome’
item.summary: President Donald Trump said Iran's national soccer team is "welcome" to play in the World Cup, but cautioned it might not be "appropriate" to compete amid the ongoing conflict.

item.title: Dems vote to keep DHS closed despite airport chaos, Iranian sleeper cell threat
item.summary: Senate Democrats pushed piecemeal funding for TSA and FEMA, while Republicans resisted carving out ICE from broader DHS budget amid ongoing shutdown battle.

item.title: NYPD heroes, inspired by 9/11, ran toward danger as suspected terrorists targeted NYC
item.summary: NYPD officers open up about running toward danger during a suspected terror incident near Gracie Mansion, as a viral image shows the chief hurdling a barricade.

item.title: Pentagon estimates Iran war cost $11.3B in the first six days in closed-door congressional hearing: report
item.summary: The Pentagon reportedly told legislators in a closed-door briefing that the estimated cost of the war against Iran during the initial six days was over $11.3 billion.

item.title: California rideshare driver accused of assaulting drunk woman, and police fear there are more victims
item.summary: Rideshare driver Felipe Rico-Ceballos charged with kidnapping and sexual assault after allegedly attacking passenger in Costa Mesa. Police seek additional victims.

item.title: Aging could slow down with one common daily habit: 'Live longer and better'
item.summary: Daily multivitamin use slowed biological aging by about four months in a two-year study of nearly 1,000 participants, with the biggest benefits in older adults.

item.title: Schumer swings at Hegseth over king crab meals for the troops, but Biden-era receipts show similar tab
item.summary: Schumer allegedly ignored similar Pentagon luxury spending under Austin while criticizing Hegseth's $93.4 billion September expenses on various items.

item.title: US Army offers up to $5,000 reward for information after 4 drones stolen from Fort Campbell in Kentucky
item.summary: The U.S. Army is offering up to $5,000 for a tip that yields the arrest and conviction of thieves who stole drones from Fort Campbell in Kentucky.

item.title: Manchin rips Cornyn for filibuster flip as Texas GOP runoff looms
item.summary: Former senator Joe Manchin accused John Cornyn of abandoning his longstanding support for the filibuster for political convenience, calling the reversal "deeply disappointing."
